raw.description:
About the BIIE

The Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering (BIIE) is an independent Swiss research institute advancing immune engineering to improve the health of children and adolescents, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The Institute brings together expertise across immunology, bioengineering, computational biology and artificial intelligence, combining fundamental research with a focus on translating scientific discoveries into practical and accessible health solutions. Established through the initiative of Fondation Botnar, the BIIE is a young and growing international research institute based in the Basel region.

Position Overview

We are seeking a creative, proactive and versatile Communications Officer to help bring the research, people and mission of the BIIE to a wide range of audiences.

Reporting to the Head of Communications & Institute Relations, and working closely with scientific and administrative colleagues across the institute, you will help translate complex scientific topics and lead the planning and execution of a broad range of communications activities.

This is a hands-on role, covering digital communications, content creation, internal communications, events and the production of institutional materials. You will take responsibility for content management on the BIIE's website and the Institute’s LinkedIn channel, and the organisation of internal and external events.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation

  • Develop, write, edit and design engaging content for different audiences and channels, including news articles, press releases, newsletters, presentations, flyers and institutional materials.
  • Work with scientists and colleagues across the Institute as well as partner organisations to identify compelling stories and translate complex scientific topics into clear, accessible content.
  • Coordinate the production of visual and multimedia content, including photography, video and graphics.

Website & Social Media

  • Further develop and manage the day-to-day content of the BIIE website, ensuring it remains accurate, engaging and up to date.
  • Plan and coordinate digital content through an editorial calendar, proactively identifying opportunities for storytelling.
  • Monitor digital performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Internal Communications

  • Develop and maintain effective internal communications channels to keep employees informed, connected and engaged.
  • Create and coordinate internal news, announcements and other communications materials.
  • Support all-staff meetings and other internal activities that strengthen the BIIE community and foster a shared institutional identity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Events

  • Support media relations activities, including media enquiries, press materials, media lists and monitoring.
  • Support stakeholder engagement activities, coordinating visits and meetings, and maintaining institutional contacts in a dedicated CRM.
  • Plan and coordinate internal and external BIIE events, including scientific events, stakeholder events, visits and institutional activities.
  • Manage event logistics and communications, including invitations, programmes, briefings, promotional materials and follow-up activities.

Communications Strategy & General Support

  • Support the Head of Communications & Institute Relations in establishing and implementing the BIIE's Communications and Institute relation Strategy and related priorities.
  • Ensure consistent application of the BIIE's key messages, tone of voice and visual identity across communications activities and materials.
  • Support the planning, coordination and implementation of communications projects and campaigns across the Institute.

Required Qualifications

Essential

  • University degree in communications, journalism, or a related field.
  • At least 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in communications, science communication, journalism or a related role.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills in English and German.
  • Experience creating and managing content in particular for digital channels.
  • Ability to understand complex scientific topics and translate them into accurate, accessible and engaging content for wider audiences.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills.
  • Ability and confidence to work directly with leading scientists and subject-matter experts.
  • A proactive, collaborative and hands-on working style, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and growing organisation.

Preferred

  • Background or professional experience in academia, life sciences, pharma, biotechnology, global health or another field relevant to the BIIE.
  • Experience with website content management systems and digital analytics.
  • Experience with visual communications and design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva.
  • Experience producing or commissioning photography, video or other multimedia content.
  • Additional languages apart from English and German.
  • Experience working in an international and multicultural environment.

title: Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health
description:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.

The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. 

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Portfolio Management

  • Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.
  • Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.
  • Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.

Technical Leadership and Program Development

  • Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.
  • Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.
  • Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.

Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships

  • Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.
  • Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.

Performance, Learning and Accountability

  • Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.
  • Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.

Qualifications

Education

  • Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.

Experience

  • At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.
  • Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.
  • Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.
  • Fluency in English required; proficiency in French desirable.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30% during program start-up and up to 25% thereafter.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $150,000 to $170,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits 
  • Up-to-date computer equipment 

Anticipated Application Deadline: 27 November 2026 (This position may close earlier if a high volume of applications is received before the stated deadline)

RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. Resolve to Save Lives complies with all applicable US EEO laws.

About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. 

You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. 

This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment.

  • Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work.

  • A systematic, process-oriented way of working.

  • The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems.

  • A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements.

  • The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices.

Nice to have:

  • Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working.

  • Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required.

  • Experience with MDSAP

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including pension plan 

  • 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position 

  • Hybrid work model 

  • Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht 

  • Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away.

  • Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics 

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it.

title: Afstudeerstage | Marketing & Propositieontwikkeling
description: Hoe vertaal je marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar sterke proposities die zichtbaar zijn en commerciële kansen creëren? Tijdens deze hbo- of wo-afstudeerstage bij Risk Solutions, onderdeel van Centric, ga je aan de slag met een uitdagend vraagstuk waarin marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en procesoptimalisatie samenkomen. Risk Solutions ondersteunt organisaties bij het beheersen van financiële, operationele en compliance-risico’s. Denk aan oplossingen en dienstverlening rondom kredietacceptatie, risicobeoordeling, Wwft, AML, KYC en fraudebeheersing. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over de markt, klanten, risico’s en wetgeving. De uitdaging is om deze kennis te vertalen naar duidelijke proposities en gerichte commerciële en marketingactiviteiten. Jouw afstudeeropdracht Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je kijkt waar het proces beter of efficiënter kan en werkt daarbij samen met collega’s uit onder andere Marketing, Sales, Business Consultancy, Compliance en Risk Management. De centrale vraag tijdens jouw afstudeerstage is: Hoe kan Risk Solutions het marketing- en propositieproces zo inrichten dat nieuwe proposities met beperkte capaciteit sneller en consistenter in de markt worden gezet en de zichtbaarheid, vindbaarheid en commerciële opvolging worden verbeterd? Je onderzoekt ook wat er in de markt speelt en hoe andere aanbieders hun oplossingen presenteren. Daarbij verdiep je je onder andere in kredietacceptatie, financiële risico’s, AML, Wwft, KYC en fraudepreventie. Je onderzoekt welke financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken bij klanten spelen, hoe organisaties daarmee omgaan en welke waarde verschillende oplossingen daarbij bieden. Ook kijk je naar wat belangrijk is voor bijvoorbeeld een Compliance Officer, Risk Manager, kredietmanager of directielid. Daarnaast onderzoek je de zichtbaarheid van de verschillende proposities. Je kijkt hoe kanalen en middelen zoals de website, SEO, LinkedIn, klantcases, whitepapers, nieuwsbrieven, webinars en evenementen worden ingezet en waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Ook onderzoek je welke werkzaamheden slimmer kunnen worden ingericht en waar AI kan ondersteunen. Op basis van je onderzoek ontwikkel je een Marketing & Proposition Launch Framework . Hierin leg je een vaste werkwijze vast om een propositie van idee en positionering naar content, campagne, leadopvolging en evaluatie te brengen. Je maakt hiervoor praktische hulpmiddelen, zoals templates voor proposities en campagnes, afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om resultaten te meten. Tijdens je stage test je deze werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie. Samen met de betrokken collega’s doorloop je de verschillende stappen en maak je bijvoorbeeld een propositiecanvas, contentplan, campagne-opzet of salesmateriaal. Op basis van wat je in de praktijk tegenkomt, pas je de werkwijze aan. Zo ligt er aan het einde van je stage een aanpak die het team daarna zelf kan blijven gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Je analyseert het huidige proces, van marktontwikkeling en propositie tot campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je onderzoekt de markt en concurrenten en verdiept je in de financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken die bij klanten spelen. Je onderzoekt hoe proposities het beste in de markt kunnen worden gezet en welke content en kanalen bijdragen aan meer zichtbaarheid en vindbaarheid. Je kijkt hoe AI en automatisering kunnen helpen om werkzaamheden slimmer en efficiënter uit te voeren. Je test de ontwikkelde werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie en gebruikt de resultaten om deze verder te verbeteren. Je sluit je stage af met meer dan alleen een onderzoeksrapport. Je levert een geteste en praktische werkwijze op die het team daarna kan blijven gebruiken, inclusief hulpmiddelen, duidelijke afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om de resultaten te volgen. Dit krijg je Een afstudeerstage waarin je niet alleen onderzoekt, maar ook ontwikkelt en test Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ideeën Een laptop van de zaak Toegang tot de Centric Academy Een stagevergoeding van €550 per maand op basis van 40 uur per week Leuke activiteiten en borrels Dit breng je mee Voor deze afstudeerstage volg je een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Commerciële Economie, Marketing, Bedrijfskunde, International Business, Finance & Control, Finance, Communicatie, Business Innovation of een vergelijkbare studie. Volg je een wo-master en zoek je een meewerkstage waarin je onderzoek met praktijkervaring kunt combineren? Ook dan ben je van harte welkom om te solliciteren. title: Responsable d'agence F/H
description: 1958, Fondasol réalise avec succès sa première mission géotechnique. Aujourd'hui, avec plus de 10 domaines d'expertise, le Groupe Fondasol est la référence en études et ingénierie conseil de la construction. Géotechnique, hydrogéologie, géothermie, sites et sols pollués, géophysique, études de structures…: ses collaborateurs mutualisent leurs compétences pour aider les acteurs de la construction à bâtir durablement leurs projets. Grâce à son actionnariat salarié majoritaire, le Groupe Fondasol continue de renforcer les synergies entre ses expertises, crée des outils digitaux innovants, décarbone ses activités… Autant dire qu'ici, passion de son métier, engagement, évolution… sont des évidences. Prêt à conjuguer votre leadership, votre fibre commerciale et votre expertise dans un rôle à fort impact? Rejoignez le Groupe Fondasol pour prendre les rênes de notre future agence rennaise et participer activement à l’implantation du Groupe sur un nouveau territoire stratégique. Votre mission : créer, structurer et développer notre présence à Rennes. Véritable entrepreneur au sein du Groupe, vous pilotez la création complète de l’agence : développement commercial, structuration opérationnelle, recrutement progressif et représentation locale. A la fois grand ordonnateur, gestionnaire et optimisateur, vous êtes porté par un fort esprit d’entreprendre , qui contribue activement à la bonne gestion de votre agence. De la phase commerciale au déploiement du projet stratégique et de transformation du Groupe, vous contribuez à la chaine de valeur et à l’image de marque du Groupe Fondasol. Vos principales missions Vous assurez le développement commercial , en proposant l’ensemble de nos expertises et solutions innovantes (Géotechnique, Hydrogéologie, Environnement, Pathologie des Structures, etc.). Vous êtes le garant de la qualité de la relation client et de l'acquisition de nouveaux projets. Excellent gestionnaire, vous assurez la traduction de vos actions en performance économique , optimisant la rentabilité de vos agences Vous êtes impliqué dans les projets stratégiques du Groupe et contribuez aux décisions clés (innovations métier, projet stratégique et de transformation du Groupe, décisions stratégiques…). Représentez Fondasol auprès des acteurs majeurs du territoire , consolidant notre image de marque et nos partenariats. Votre future équipe Dans un premier temps, vous démarrez en autonomie, accompagné de près par les équipes techniques, commerciales et RH du Groupe. Votre rôle sera ensuite de constituer et structurer votre équipe , en recrutant progressivement les talents nécessaires au développement de l’agence. Vous bénéficierez du soutien d’un réseau national d’ingénieurs et d’experts, véritable force d’ingénierie prête à collaborer pour concrétiser nos ambitions sur le Grand Ouest. Vos principaux alliés Une image de marque forte, héritée de plus de 65 ans d’expertise dans les sols et les structures. Une galaxie d’outils digitaux de pointe développés en interne, pour maximiser efficacité et qualité. Une organisation solide en filière Ingénierie et Investigations. Le soutien des fonctions support (technique, commercial, RH…). Un projet d’entreprise unique, porté par un actionnariat salarié majoritaire (75 % du capital détenu par les collaborateurs). Profil recherché Diplômé d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un Master en Géotechnique, Génie Civil ou Travaux Publics. Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans une fonction similaire (bureau d’ingénierie géotechnique, fondations spéciales…). Excellentes capacités d’organisation, de gestion et d’analyse. Leadership naturel, sens du collectif et qualités humaines affirmées. Goût prononcé pour le développement, la création et l’entrepreneuriat. title: Senior AI Developer, Agentic Systems
description: Company Description Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here. Your role At Workleap, our engineering teams already ships more than twice as fast with AI. Now we’re expanding beyond code to everything around it: briefs, specs, design, launch, and measurement. The idea is simple: agents do the work, and people make the calls. We’ve are rethinking how we build products and are exploring the technical possibilities, this is just the beginning. As a Senior AI Developer, you’ll join us to shape and build this solution ensuring that we have solid technical foundation. Your impact: Ship the first production agents with our Product Managers, starting with brief creation and the ProductManager-to-design handoff, then extend to the rest of the product lifecycle. Shape the shared architecture and standards (orchestration, skills, memory, evals, guardrails) so that both our product lines are built on the same foundation. Own the production quality of these agents: observability, testing, security, and cost built in from the start, with human approval at every gate. Co-design with Product Managers: understand how they work, reuse what they’ve already automated, and ship small iterations they test and adopt. Measure what works: time saved, time from customer signal to shipped decision, and cost per agent and per feature, then cut what doesn’t add value. Grow others: share your agent development practices so the team can build, run, and improve agents on their own. Your team Over the next 6 to 12 months, you’ll work on questions like: how does an agent turn an idea into a brief that a Product Manager approves without rewriting it? How do specialized agents pass context without losing it or blowing up costs? How do we decide an agent is reliable enough to lighten a gate? The vision is set, and a proof of concept in Slack is underway: you’re joining early enough to shape the architecture and turn this start into a production standard. You’ll join the Product Ops team , a small team serving Product Manager across two product lines that already owns tracking, product data quality, and analytics. You’ll work daily with this team, our AI-Software Development Life Cycle team, which already automates software delivery, and with our Product Managers working on both product lines. raw.jobDescription:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent, our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

At Workleap, our engineering teams already ships more than twice as fast with AI. Now we’re expanding beyond code to everything around it: briefs, specs, design, launch, and measurement. The idea is simple: agents do the work, and people make the calls. We’ve are rethinking how we build products and are exploring the technical possibilities, this is just the beginning. As a Senior AI Developer, you’ll join us to shape and build this solution ensuring that we have solid technical foundation.

Your impact:

  • Ship the first production agents with our Product Managers, starting with brief creation and the ProductManager-to-design handoff, then extend to the rest of the product lifecycle.
  • Shape the shared architecture and standards (orchestration, skills, memory, evals, guardrails) so that both our product lines are built on the same foundation.
  • Own the production quality of these agents: observability, testing, security, and cost built in from the start, with human approval at every gate.
  • Co-design with Product Managers: understand how they work, reuse what they’ve already automated, and ship small iterations they test and adopt.
  • Measure what works: time saved, time from customer signal to shipped decision, and cost per agent and per feature, then cut what doesn’t add value.
  • Grow others: share your agent development practices so the team can build, run, and improve agents on their own.

Your team

Over the next 6 to 12 months, you’ll work on questions like: how does an agent turn an idea into a brief that a Product Manager approves without rewriting it? How do specialized agents pass context without losing it or blowing up costs? How do we decide an agent is reliable enough to lighten a gate? The vision is set, and a proof of concept in Slack is underway: you’re joining early enough to shape the architecture and turn this start into a production standard.

You’ll join the Product Ops team, a small team serving Product Manager across two product lines that already owns tracking, product data quality, and analytics. You’ll work daily with this team, our AI-Software Development Life Cycle team, which already automates software delivery, and with our Product Managers working on both product lines. You’ll also partner with the Senior AI Developer on our Data team to share patterns and tooling. We use AI every day, decide fast, and ship in iterations.

Our technology ecosystem includes Claude (Claude Code, skills, Managed Agents, Design), MCP, Slack, Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Mixpanel, Snowflake, Azure, etc.

What you'll bring

  • Strong production engineering across the agent development lifecycle;
  • Hands-on experience designing and shipping multi-agent systems to production: orchestration, tools, context, and memory, integrated with tools like Slack, Atlassian, and MCP;
  • Experience instrumenting and evaluating non-deterministic systems: evals, observability, regression testing, and cost tracking;
  • Sound architectural judgment across reliability, security, and cost, including which model fits which job, and the confidence to form and defend a technical opinion;
  • Experience building components or tooling that other people adopt;
  • Real product sense: you understand how a Product Manager works and you build with users, not for them;
  • A taste for building as a team and helping people change how they work, by sharing your practices;
  • A builder mindset: you own what you ship, you’re comfortable with the ambiguity of an early-stage project, and you use AI-assisted development tools daily and critically;
  • Bonus: product management experience, or experience on a B2B SaaS, HR, or IT product.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

The internal title for this role is Senior AI Developer - Product Operations.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $140,000 - $170,000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.

description: GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands. On behalf of Feeld , GT is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help them improve their inclusive dating application. About the Client Founded in 2014 as a dating app, Feeld gathered millions of users in one place to create a safer and more inclusive space online for everyone open to experiencing people and relationships in a new way. GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of Feeld, GT is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help them improve their inclusive dating application.

About the Client

Founded in 2014 as a dating app, Feeld gathered millions of users in one place to create a safer and more inclusive space online for everyone open to experiencing people and relationships in a new way. Their mission is to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships and create a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves.

The technology stack of the project: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL/REST, TypeScript, AWS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, SQS, EventBridge, WebSockets.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Mobile Monetisation) to take ownership of the backend systems powering Feeld's subscription and in-app purchase experiences across iOS and Android.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with mobile monetisation platforms such as Adapty, RevenueCat, or similar solutions, as well as integrating mobile payment flows with custom backend services. This includes managing subscription lifecycles, synchronising payment data, handling receipts, and ensuring accurate entitlement management.

We're looking for a highly experienced, proactive engineer with the potential to act as a technical lead, capable of independently driving complex technical initiatives, contributing to architectural decisions, and ensuring the reliability and scalability of revenue-critical systems.

📌 Full-time, long-term
⌛️ Preferred immediate start

Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the backend systems supporting Feeld’s monetisation, ensuring their reliability, performance, and contribution to business goals.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and integrations for subscriptions, billing, payment processing, entitlements, pricing, and promotional features.

  • Ensure the accuracy, stability, and reliability of monetisation flows, proactively identifying and resolving production issues that could impact revenue or user experience.

  • Support the development and optimisation of subscription and payment flows, including improvements to system performance, scalability, and error handling.

  • Implement and maintain feature flags, testing, and analytics instrumentation to support experimentation and continuous improvement of monetisation features.

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to build and improve analytics and reporting capabilities, providing insights into revenue performance, user behaviour, and system health.

Essential knowledge, skills & experience:

  • 5+ years of commercial backend development experience, ideally building high-load, business-critical systems.

  • Proven experience with mobile monetisation and subscription platforms, such as Adapty, RevenueCat, or comparable solutions.

  • Hands-on experience implementing mobile in-app purchases and subscription flows for iOS and/or Android applications, beyond web-based payment integrations.

  • Experience integrating mobile payment platforms with custom backend systems, including payment data synchronisation, receipt handling, subscription status tracking, and entitlement management.

  • Strong understanding of mobile subscription and payment lifecycles, including renewals, cancellations, refunds, failed payments, and subscription state changes.

  • Experience ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of revenue-critical backend systems, including troubleshooting production issues.

  • Strong backend development experience with Node.js or TypeScript or JavaScript, ideally using NestJS and building GraphQL or REST APIs.

  • Good understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.

  • Experience writing reliable unit and integration tests.

  • Strong technical ownership, independent problem-solving, and architectural decision-making skills, with the potential to take on technical leadership responsibilities.

  • Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, SQL and NoSQL databases. Our current stack includes ECS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge, and PostgreSQL.

  • Experience working directly with Apple App Store and Google Play billing ecosystems.

  • Experience running monetisation experiments, including A/B testing, subscription pricing changes, and conversion optimisation.

  • Experience managing regional pricing, multiple currencies, and country-specific monetisation strategies.

  • Experience analysing the performance of monetisation experiments, including revenue, subscription conversion, and retention metrics.

  • Previous experience acting as a Tech Lead or Lead Backend Engineer, mentoring engineers, and driving technical decisions.

  2. GT technical interview

  3. Client technical interview

  4. Final interview

  5. Reference Check

  6. Offer

title: Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist, Post Graduate Trainee
description:
The Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist (post-grad trainee) will join the International Medical TTR team and report to International Medical Strategy & Operations. The post-grad trainee will support the planning, governance and execution of the international Medical Affairs Strategy for ATTR-CM across Alnylam's international markets, working closely with regional and country Medical teams and cross-functional partners. The role contributes to medical operations and planning deliverables, evidence generation portfolio, scientific engagement and insight programs, field medical excellence initiatives and patient experience work and offers first-hand insight into how a regional Medical Affairs organization is run. The scope is intentionally flexible: the more capability, initiative and curiosity the post-grad trainee brings, the more the remit can expand, in line with results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the International Medical Strategy & Operations team in planning, tracking and reporting on International Medical TTR strategic priorities and operating-model deliverables across international markets
  • Help with the preparation of management materials, such as leadership updates, pre-reads, meeting materials and executive presentations, turning complex information into clear, decision-ready outputs
  • Support medical planning and budget cycles by consolidating regional and country inputs, tracking spend against plan and preparing summaries, in partnership with Finance
  • Contribute to evidence generation portfolio management by maintaining study trackers (e.g., investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations) and partnering with in preparing status, milestone and timeline overviews
  • Support scientific engagement and medical education activities, including the speaker engagement process and congress planning, all scientific and non-promotional in nature
  • Contribute to the TOP 41 Centers of Excellence (CoE) program, supporting the project owner in engagement mapping; this is a potential area where the post-grad trainee may take ownership of project deliverables, depending on experience and interest
  • Support field medical excellence initiatives, such as field medical KPIs and dashboards, the quarterly medical insights process, training roll-out
  • Contribute to patient experience work, including patient advocacy and engagement and patient support programs
  • Gain first-hand insight into the regional medical leadership agenda by supporting cross-functional planning, governance meetings and operational follow-up
  • Depending on experience and interest, support projects on AI-enabled tools, CRM and insights platforms, and other emerging medical priorities

Qualifications

  • Availability for a minimum of 9 months; 12 months is strongly preferred
  • Completed bachelor's degree; a master's degree is a plus
  • Academic background in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, public health or another analytical discipline is preferred; interest in Medical Affairs, cardiology or rare diseases is valued
  • Strong logical and analytical thinking, with the ability to navigate complexity and structure ambiguous problems
  • Ability to read, interpret and critically summarize scientific and clinical literature
  • Awareness of, or willingness to learn, the compliance principles that govern Medical Affairs
  • Advance PowerPoint and Excel skills; confidence using Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled productivity tools is highly valued
  • Fast learner, proactive and adaptive, taking ownership of high-quality outputs and handling confidential information with discretion
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus
  • Flexibility to work 2-3 days per week in the Zug office; occasional travel possible (mainly EU)
  • Collaborative, flexible and comfortable working in a fast-moving, cross-functional and international environment

What We Bring

  • The opportunity to join a highly motivated, science-driven team in a leading RNAi therapeutics company 
  • Hands-on exposure to how International Medical Affairs supports the AMVUTTRA ATTR-CM launch, with a focus on science, evidence and patients 
  • The chance to contribute to Alnylam's mission of bringing groundbreaking medicines to patients 
  • Direct one-to-one mentoring, supportive supervision, and regular development feedback 
  • Collaboration with a diverse team of experts across medicine, scientific engagement, evidence generation, patient experience, and analytics 
  • A strong office community, with events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across functions and disciplines 

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:

  • Linux running on embedded hardware
  • C/C++, Python & Bash codebases
  • Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.
  • Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.
  • Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.
  • Provide expert support (L3) to customers facing technical issues.
  • Write clear and concise internal documentation, in addition to contributing to the public-facing knowledge base.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, as well as release planning and task prioritization meetings.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python code in a professional setting.
  • Extensive experience working with embedded architectures, including cross-compilation, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • Expert Linux skills, with an excellent grasp of command line operations, resource management, systems services and networking.
  • Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel, embedded device drivers, device tree configuration and u-boot.
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Debian packaging workflows and managing complex Docker environments.
  • Knowledge of OTA updates (e.g. mender).
  • Proficient in networking concepts across all layers of the OSI model, including connectors, and hardware interfaces, IP addressing, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.
  • Skilled in using network diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump) to identify and resolve network issues.
  • Basic embedded security knowledge, such as secure boot on embedded devices and/or UEFI, boot chain verification.
  • Proven experience with network security protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS, VPNs) and best practices for securing embedded devices, such as secure boot and encryption mechanisms.
  • Basic electrical engineering experience, such as familiarity with schematics and the instrumentation required to debug communication over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN bus.
  • Bonus: Experience with video streaming and MIPI CSI drivers.
  • Bonus: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Experience with NXP iMX8 platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Previous contributions to open source projects, especially in the Linux ecosystem.
  • Bonus: Experience with CI/CD systems, such as Jenkins, GitHub actions, GitLab CI.
  • Experience working in an agile environment, providing daily updates in stand-ups and managing tasks in a sprint board.
  • A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives.
  • EU Citizenship required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Product Engineering
description: Product Engineering at Polar Product engineering at Polar is about shaping and building the finance layer for the next generation of AI products. We’re rethinking how billing works for a world of usage-based software, programmable pricing and AI agents – from real-time metering and pricing as code, to more flexible customer identities, giving developers greater control over how they monetize their products. We’re interested in engineers who enjoy working across our entire stack, solving complex technical challenges while shaping how developers interact with and experience Polar. We value engineers who think beyond implementation, challenge assumptions and bring the technical depth and product judgement to make sophisticated systems feel simple. We operate as a small, remote-first team with a strong bias towards shipping. We value engineers who can work independently, collaborate when it matters and maintain a high bar for quality without sacrificing speed. More about Polar and how we work What you could work on Depending on your experience and where you can have the greatest impact, this could include: Own product development end-to-end: Identifying opportunities, shipping and iterating on features across our stack – taking responsibility for both the technical implementation and the product outcome. Build exceptional developer experiences: Bringing a strong eye for design, usability and detail to everything you ship. Turning complex billing and monetization workflows into intuitive interfaces, powerful APIs and thoughtful abstractions that make our merchants’ lives easier. Ship with speed and quality: Delivering improvements continuously, balancing fast iterations with robust engineering, performance and attention to detail. Stay close to our users: Engaging with our merchants, to understand how they use Polar, uncover pain points and translate feedback into meaningful product improvements. What we look for We’re particularly interested in senior engineers who combine strong technical foundations with exceptional product judgement and design sensibility. People who care deeply about developer experience, have opinions about what makes great software and know that building the right thing often means knowing what not to build. Some of the qualities and experience we value in this area include: Strong technical foundations: Experience building, shipping and evolving production software, with deep expertise in at least one part of the stack and the ability to work confidently across frontend and backend systems. You’ve built and maintained products long enough to understand how early technical and product decisions hold up as they evolve and scale. Product judgement & design sensibility: A deep appreciation for how products look, feel and work. An understanding that developer experience is the product, from the clarity of an API to the smallest details of an interface. Strong opinions, loosely held, and the judgement to challenge assumptions, simplify complexity and know what to leave out. Ownership & pragmatic execution: The ability to take problems end-to-end with high ownership and autonomy, navigate ambiguity, make decisions without perfect information and take responsibility for outcomes. A bias towards shipping and knowing when to iterate quickly and when to invest in stronger foundations. Engineering craft: A commitment to the quality of what gets built – from clean APIs and robust backend logic to thoughtful interactions, edge-case handling and performance. High standards for both technical quality and the experience delivered. Curiosity & collaboration: A willingness to wear multiple hats, collaborate openly and contribute to a small team. Curiosity to learn new technologies and use tools, including AI-assisted development, while maintaining intimacy with the code, sound engineering judgement and ownership of what gets shipped. Experience with payments, billing or developer tools is a strong plus. We also love seeing open-source contributions and side projects. Our stack Frontend: Typescript (React, Effect) Backend: Python (FastAPI, Dramatiq) Infrastructure: Postgres, Clickhouse, AWS.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Product
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. The Data Product team collaborates with an experienced group of data scientists, engineers, and product managers to build highly scalable features that power TRM's products and services. As a Data Engineer on the Data Product team, you will be responsible for designing and building mission-critical data services. These features analyze and provide insights into blockchain transaction activity at petabyte scale, and ultimately work to build a safer financial system for billions of people.. The impact you’ll have here: Build highly scalable features that integrate with dozens of blockchains. Design and architect intricate data models for optimal storage and retrieval to support sub-second latency for querying blockchain data. Collaborate across departments, partnering with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to design and implement novel data models that enhance TRM’s products. Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

description: This role is part of our Usersnap team, one of our growing brands at saas.group. We're looking for a hands-on AI Lead / Engineering Manager to lead the small engineering team that ships these capabilities, and to set the technical direction while doing it. raw.jobDescription:
This role is part of our Usersnap team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.

Profile Overview

Usersnap is building AI-driven capabilities into the core of the product, from automated setup to intelligent surveys, contextual analysis, and reporting that generates itself based on connectors. We're looking for a hands-on AI Lead / Engineering Manager to lead the small engineering team that ships these capabilities, and to set the technical direction while doing it.

This is a player-coach role. You'll write and review code, make architecture calls, and define what "good" looks like for AI-native development. You'll also own team coordination, delivery timelines, workload allocation, and follow-through, so that work planned is work shipped, reliably and at production quality.

This is a full-time, engineering-led role. It is not combined with product management: the technical leadership scope is substantial on its own, and you'll partner with Product rather than absorb it.

AI capability is becoming core to Usersnap's product and go-to-market, especially as we move upmarket. You'll be the person who makes sure it ships well.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • You'll have established a clear delivery rhythm for the team: shared priorities, realistic timelines, visible workload, and projects that get followed through to launch
  • You'll have assessed the current state of the codebase, tooling, and practices, and set out a concrete engineering bar covering observability, testing, security, and architecture
  • You'll have shipped at least one AI-powered feature to production with the team, from prototype through launch, using timeboxed AI development
  • You'll have built a strong working relationship with Product and the rest of the company, and be seen as a reliable owner of ambiguous, technically complex work
  • You'll have raised the team's standards while keeping people motivated and engaged

Your responsibilities

Team leadership and delivery

  • Own team coordination, delivery timelines, workload allocation, and project follow-through for a small engineering team
  • Keep work moving: break down ambiguous goals, sequence them with Product, flag slippage early, and make sure commitments are met
  • Give clear, constructive technical feedback in code review, design discussions, and 1:1s, and raise standards without demotivating people
  • Grow the team's capability, including how we use AI tooling to work faster without lowering quality

Technical leadership

  • Assess the current engineering bar and raise it. Define what "good" looks like for AI-native development, and make it the shared standard
  • Set and enforce expectations in five areas:
    • Observability: logging, monitoring, and tracing that make AI behavior, cost, and failures visible
    • Testing: strong test coverage and automated-testing rigor, including evaluation of AI outputs
    • Security and compliance: secure-by-default practices, as we move upmarket
    • Scalable architecture and data pipelines: designs that hold up as usage and integrations grow
    • Timeboxing: practical limits on AI development work, so exploration stays bounded and ships
  • Own or steward key architecture decisions, including model selection and integration approach, and the tradeoffs between quality, cost, and latency
  • Flag technical risks early, especially around AI reliability, cost, and edge-case behavior

Hands-on contribution

  • Design, build, and ship AI-powered features alongside the team, from prototyping through production quality
  • Work hands-on with LLMs, embeddings, and related AI tooling to solve real product problems
  • Build across the stack as needed. Every feature you ship should be tested, monitored, and maintainable

Partnership

  • Partner with Product on requirements and priorities, pushing back with technical reality when needed
  • Partner with company leadership on technical planning, resourcing, and sequencing

What You bring to the table

  • Leadership

    • Hands-on technical leadership with real engineering vision. You've led delivery for a small team, ideally for 2-3 years of people leadership, as a tech lead, engineering manager, or player-coach. Formal people-management experience is useful, but the essential need is someone who can wrangle delivery and provide senior technical direction
    • A style that raises the bar. You give direct, specific technical feedback and hold high standards, and the team leaves those conversations more capable and more motivated
    • Delivery discipline. You're comfortable owning timelines, allocating work, and following projects through to the end

    Technical depth

    • 7+ years of software engineering experience, and you've shipped AI features to production and owned the lifecycle from problem framing to post-launch iteration, not just prototypes or AI-assisted coding
    • Strong fullstack fundamentals. Comfortable across frontend, backend, and infrastructure as needed
    • Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, or similar techniques in live systems, with good judgment about when AI is the right tool and when it isn't
    • Observability and testing rigor. You build in logging, monitoring, and tracing from the start, and you insist on strong test coverage and automated testing, including evaluation of AI behavior
    • Scalable architecture and data pipelines. Solid SQL, schema design, and the ability to design pipelines and systems that scale
    • Evaluation mindset. You define success metrics, design experiments, run offline and online evaluations, and make decisions from the results
    • Production readiness. Docker fluency, CI/CD, and good habits for versioning prompts, models, and datasets
    • LLM platform breadth. Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, working with vector databases, and using LangChain (or similar); comfortable fine-tuning when it truly makes sense
    • Security and compliance experience, or a strong interest in it, as we move upmarket
    • Practical timeboxing of AI development work. You know how to keep AI exploration bounded, ship on schedule, and avoid open-ended experimentation

    How you work

    • You identify problems and propose solutions on your own, rather than waiting to be told exactly what to build
    • You're comfortable in a lean team where you own outcomes, not just tickets

What's in it for You

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

Usersnap is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

title: Creative Technologist (contract)
description: Instrument is a digitally native design and technology company built to help brands unlock their full potential. Since 2005, our team of makers, thinkers, and storytellers has partnered with leading brands like Google, Nike, Uber, ŌURA, and Eventbrite to craft digital experiences that create impact and drive results. Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t just design—we build. Our work lives at the intersection of taste and technology, powered by curiosity, thoughtful curation, and a commitment to delivering the most fitting solution for every brief. We bring this to life across three core offerings: Brand, Marketing, and Product. As a member of our freelance network, you’ll collaborate with our teams to bring bold ideas to life—whether launching new brands, building digital products, or shaping experiences that move people. We welcome collaborators from all backgrounds and experiences who share our curiosity, creativity, and care for craft. We believe great work comes from diverse perspectives and shared purpose. If you’re passionate about learning, experimenting, and making work that matters, we’d love to hear from you. The Role We’re looking for an embedded, hands-on Creative Technologist to rapidly turn emerging AI capabilities into compelling, functional experiences. Working closely with a multidisciplinary creative team, you’ll experiment with new AI model releases and capabilities, quickly moving from “what could we do with this?” to working prototypes and demos people actually want to engage with. You have your finger on the pulse of what’s happening across AI—following new launches, features, and the creative behaviors gaining traction, and recognizing opportunities to build while the conversation is happening. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who thrives in experimentation. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, curious about what’s next, and able to independently take an idea from early exploration through something polished enough to put in front of an audience. Contract: ASAP – February 26, 2027 Commitment: 40 hours/week What You'll Do Stay deeply plugged into new AI launches, features, and emerging creative behaviors, identifying opportunities to build while the conversation is happening. Rapidly concept, prototype, and ship AI-powered demos that showcase new model capabilities in timely, culturally relevant ways. Turn technical capabilities into social-first demos and experiences that are immediately understandable, compelling, and designed to earn attention. Use AI-assisted development, “vibe coding,” and rapid experimentation to move quickly from idea to working experience. Experiment beyond the obvious use case, developing creative approaches, workflows, or reusable techniques that help others push a capability further. Translate experiments into compelling outputs across formats, including working code, screen recordings, short-form social content, technical tutorials, and open-source repositories. Partner closely with creative, design, engineering, and production teams to shape ideas while bringing a strong technical point of view. Iterate quickly based on creative and technical feedback, balancing speed with a strong bar for craft and execution. What You Bring Strong hands-on experience in creative technology, prototyping, creative development, or a similar technical discipline. A portfolio demonstrating functional prototypes, interactive experiences, experiments, or other technically driven creative work. A track record of actively experimenting with new AI models, features, and capabilities as they launch, with recent examples of work that responds to emerging trends or behaviors in the AI landscape. Meaningful hands-on experience building with Gemini and Google’s AI developer ecosystem, alongside fluency in the broader generative AI landscape. Strong coding and prototyping skills using modern front-end frameworks and development tools. Strong instincts for what is gaining traction with developers and creators, why it’s resonating, and how an emerging behavior can translate into a compelling demo or piece of social-first content. Comfort experimenting with newly released models and capabilities and figuring things out without an established playbook. Strong creative instincts and an understanding of what makes a technical demo surprising, useful, entertaining, or worth sharing. The ability to work independently and move quickly from an ambiguous idea to a functional prototype with minimal hand-holding. Strong communication skills and the ability to make technical ideas accessible and exciting to both developer and broader consumer audiences. Experience creating developer-facing content, social-first creative, technical tutorials, or open-source projects is a plus. What We Offer: The expected contract pay range: $74-109 per hour. Contract compensation is determined by location, experience, and skillset. We have three regional pay ranges that are adjusted for cost of living (US1 +15%, US2 +7.5%, US3 Base), *learn more about our pay philosophy and cost of living adjustments. Benefits may be available in accordance with applicable law and company policy, including eligibility based on hours worked and duration of assignment. Compensation Additional Information
